issue.title: subscription: add a test that pause blocks subscribe and leaves no subscription record
issue.body:
## Context

contract/contracts/subscription/src/lib.rs has `Error::Paused = 4` and `subscribe` calls `Self::require_active(&env)` before loading the plan and charging. contract/contracts/subscription/src/types.rs documents `Paused` as "Contract is paused; mutating entrypoints are blocked". The pause flag lives in `Config.paused`.

## Problem

The pause guard is the emergency stop for the money path, but there is no test proving that a paused contract rejects `subscribe` before any token movement and before a `Subscription` record is written. If the guard were moved after `charge`, a paused contract would still take fan funds.

## Expected behavior

A test asserts that with the contract paused, `subscribe` fails with `Paused`, the fan's token balance is unchanged, and no subscription is readable for the (fan, creator) pair.

## Implementation guidance

Add a test to contract/contracts/subscription/src/lib.rs. Initialize the contract, create a plan, set `Config.paused = true` (via the admin pause entrypoint if present, otherwise by writing the `DataKey::Config` value the way `init` does), then call `subscribe` and assert the failure. Register a token contract so a balance assertion is meaningful.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cargo test -p subscription` passes.
- [ ] A test asserts `subscribe` on a paused contract fails with `Paused`.
- [ ] The same test asserts the fan's token balance is unchanged after the rejected call.
- [ ] The same test asserts no `Subscription` record exists for the (fan, creator) pair after the rejected call.

## Relevant files

- `contract/contracts/subscription/src/lib.rs`
- `contract/contracts/subscription/src/types.rs`
- `contract/contracts/myfans-token/src/lib.rs`

## Scope

Difficulty: intermediate
Estimated: small

issue.title: Implement Italian Fiscal Code in Kotlin

labels.name: new-language
labels.description: Implement the algorithm in a language not yet covered

milestone.title: 64 languages
milestone.description: 2⁶ — built by the core team in sessions of ten languages. See ROADMAP.md.

issue.body:
Implement the Italian Fiscal Code algorithm in **Kotlin** and get it verified by the shared test suite.

### What to build

A program that reads one JSON object on stdin and writes the fiscal code (or an error) as JSON on stdout, exactly as described in [SPECIFICATION.md](https://github.com/openapi/every-language-fiscal-code/blob/main/SPECIFICATION.md).

```console
$ echo '{"surname":"ROSSI","name":"MARIO","birth_date":"1980-01-01","sex":"M","birthplace_code":"H501"}' | ./elc run kotlin
{"fiscal_code": "RSSMRA80A01H501U"}
```

### Suggested setup

| | |
|---|---|
| Directory | `languages/kotlin/` |
| Family | `jvm` |
| Docker base | `eclipse-temurin:21-jdk + kotlinc` (just a suggestion) |

### Checklist

- [ ] `languages/kotlin/` with source, `Dockerfile`, `run.sh`, `manifest.yaml` and `README.md`
- [ ] The algorithm is written entirely in Kotlin (no wrappers, no fiscal-code libraries, no remote calls)
- [ ] `./elc test kotlin` passes **87/87**
- [ ] PR opened with `Closes #<this issue>`

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/openapi/every-language-fiscal-code/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Python](https://github.com/openapi/every-language-fiscal-code/tree/main/languages/python) / [PHP](https://github.com/openapi/every-language-fiscal-code/tree/main/languages/php) implementations for complete examples.

🎃 This issue is part of **Hacktoberfest**. Comment below to claim it!

issue.title: [Feat]: Data grid: copy all column names (one per line or as a JSON array)

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

issue.body:
### 🚀 Feature Proposal

Add **Copy column names → One per line / As JSON array** to the column header context menu. It copies every column of the current result, in grid order, as `id\nname\nemail` or `["id","name","email"]`.

### Motivation

Building a SELECT list, a field mapping or documentation from a result means retyping the names: the header menu only copies the name of the clicked column.

### Where to start

- Column header menu in `src/components/ui/DataGrid.tsx` (the `headerContextMenu` items, next to **Copy column name**). `ContextMenu` supports a `submenu`.
- Pure helpers in `src/utils/clipboard.ts`, e.g. `columnNamesAsLines(columns)` and `columnNamesAsJson(columns)` (`JSON.stringify(columns)`).
- Use the grid's `columns` prop: it is already in the result's original order. Columns with an empty name (e.g. `SELECT 1 AS ""`) are copied as empty strings.
- Optional: expose the same action as a result command in the command palette (`src/utils/builtInCommands.ts`).

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both entries copy all columns in grid order and show a success toast.
- [ ] The JSON output is valid and escapes quotes and backslashes in names.
- [ ] Unit tests for both helpers in `tests/utils/clipboard.test.ts`.

### Contributor notes

- Comment here before starting so the issue can be assigned to you.
- Follow the [repo rules](https://github.com/TabularisDB/tabularis/tree/main/.rules) (TypeScript, React, design tokens, accessibility, testing).
- Any new UI string needs a key in every locale under `src/i18n/locales/`.
- Run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` before opening the PR.
- Questions? Ask here or on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/K2hmhfHRSt).

issue.title: feat: add Dropbox connector
issue.body:
## What and why
Adds the Dropbox connector covering the most common file and folder operations over Dropbox's RPC v2 API:
- `files.listFolder` & `files.listFolderContinue`: Folder listing with cursor continuation
- `files.getMetadata`: File and folder metadata retrieval
- `files.search`: Content and filename search
- `files.delete`: Destructive file and folder deletion
- `sharing.createSharedLink` & `sharing.listSharedLinks`: Managing public sharing links

File upload and download endpoints (which require binary stream transfers over content endpoints) are omitted from this initial version as noted in the file.

### API Documentation Links
- [Files endpoints](https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation#files)
- [Sharing endpoints](https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation#sharing)

Status: `docs-based` (tested against fake server with full failure path coverage).

## Checklist
- [x] Tests added or updated, including failure paths
- [x] `pnpm smoke` run if `package.json`, exports, or the build changed
- [x] No secrets in logs, errors, or tool output
- [x] README/docs updated if behavior changed (`docs/connectors.md` regenerated via `pnpm catalog`)
- [x] PR title is `type: summary` (e.g. `feat: add Dropbox connector`)

comment.body:
I have addressed both issues and updated the PR:
1. **Deleted entries**: Made `id` optional on `entry` schema (`id: z.string().optional()`) and added a test verifying `files.listFolder` with deleted entries without an `id`.
2. **Missing path on `files.delete`**: Updated `detectHttpError` to match `path_lookup/not_found` as well as `path/not_found`, and added a test confirming a 409 error on `files.delete` maps to `not_found`.
3. **Pagination explanation (section 8)**: In Dropbox's API, pagination does not reuse the initial folder listing endpoint with query or body parameters; rather, subsequent pages must be requested via a distinct companion endpoint (`/files/list_folder/continue`) taking only `{ cursor }`. Because core pagination strategies currently assume a single URL across pages, we provide both `files.listFolder` and `files.listFolderContinue`.
All 3,539 tests, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm check:generated` pass cleanly. Ready for CI approval!
